title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Calendar: Filing, Adjudication, Correction and Posting Periods
content:
The periods below govern the claim cycle for every payer class of **Insurance Coverage & Claims**.

## First claim

| Payer class | Claim filed this many business days after the final report | Filing limit: calendar days after the date of service (collection date) | Clean claim normally adjudicated within (calendar days of filing) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 2 | 365 | 14 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | 3 | 365 | 30 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | 0 (filed by crossover from the primary payer) | 365 | 14 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | 3 | 180 | 30 |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | 3 | 365 | 30 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | 3 | 180 | 30 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 5 | 365 | 45 |

## After the remittance

| Payer class | Corrected or replacement claim accepted within (calendar days after a denial) | Corrected or replacement submissions allowed on one claim number | Secondary claim filed within (calendar days after the primary payer's remittance) | Patient responsibility posted to a patient invoice within (business days after the remittance) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 | 2 | 90 | 2 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | 180 | 2 | 90 | 2 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | 365 | 1 | 0 (not filed by the laboratory) | 2 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | 180 | 2 | 90 | 2 |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | 365 | 2 | 90 | 2 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | 180 | 2 | 90 | 2 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 365 | 1 | 90 | 5 |

## Notes to the calendar

1. A claim-submission figure of 0 means the claim reaches that payer by crossover from the primary payer rather than by a filing of the laboratory's own.
2. A secondary-claim figure of 0 means the laboratory does not file the secondary claim for that payer class.
3. The filing limit runs from the date of service, which is the collection date of the order.

## Reading the calendar (hypothetical figures)

- A Medicaid Managed Care Plan claim and a Commercial In-Network Plan claim share the shortest filing limit in the calendar, 180 calendar days; every other payer class allows 365.
- A Medicare Supplement Plan claim and a Commercial Out-of-Network Plan claim each allow a single corrected or replacement submission on one claim number; the other five payer classes allow 2.
- A Commercial Out-of-Network Plan claim is filed 5 business days after the final report and is normally adjudicated within 45 calendar days of filing, the longest periods in the calendar.
